title: Microsoft announces seven AI models, including a reasoning one and an "ultra efficient" coding one fine-tuned for GitHub, for businesses and to lower its costs (Rafe Rosner-Uddin/Financial Times)
summary: Rafe Rosner-Uddin / Financial Times: Microsoft announces seven AI models, including a reasoning one and an “ultra efficient” coding one fine-tuned for GitHub, for businesses and to lower its costs — Software giant's AI chief Mustafa Suleyman says focus is on developing products for business users
